column1: # One row per launchable robot. Tab-separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# id         short name passed on the command line
# submodule  directory under src/ (also the submodule that gets cloned on demand)
# path       entry point, relative to the repo root
# args       xacro args as k:=v, space separated, or - for none
# mesh_base  for URDFs with relative mesh paths: dir (relative to repo root) they resolve
#            against; rewritten to file:// at launch time. - if meshes use package://
